name: IRC_EMP_EVENTS_B
description: This is the base table to store the employee event basic details

columns.name: EMP_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the table. Auto generated.

columns.name: EVENT_NUMBER
columns.description: The unique number which gets generated to represent an employee event.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Stores the start date of the employee event.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Stores the end date of the employee event.

columns.name: LAST_REGISTER_DATE
columns.description: Stores the last date of the registration of the employee event.

columns.name: TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: Timezone code of the employee event

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the employee event which is configured in HCM_LOOKUP table. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_EMP_EVENT_STATUS.

columns.name: STATUS_UPDATED_DATE
columns.description: Date in which the status is changed for the employee event

columns.name: VISIBILITY_CODE
columns.description: Visibility code of the employee event which is configured in HCM_LOOKUP table. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_EMP_EVENT_VISIBILITY.

columns.name: CREATION_CODE
columns.description: The creation mode of the employee event which is configured in HCM_LOOKUP table. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_EMP_EVENT_CREATION.

columns.name: EVENT_LAST_MODIFIED_DATE
columns.description: Date in which the event details is last modified

columns.name: OBJECT_STATUS
columns.description: Stores the status of the Object as a lookup code. The corresponding lookup type is ORA_IRC_OBJECT_STATUS.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
